comment: NW.js desktop edition feature whitelist. Base list extracted from the FeatureList/PlatformTree data inside upstream/websitecompiler/NodeWebkit-Commander.wcc (the official closed-source WebSite Compiler project file). NetAuth, DesktopClipboard and DesktopRecorder were added later upstream than that .wcc snapshot but are present in the official 0.9.5 desktop build, so they are enabled too. **ClosureAdvancedMode (window[...] externs used only for Closure advanced minification) is intentionally NOT enabled: official desktop builds strip those blocks, and upstream 0.9.6 exports symbols there whose definitions are commented out (e.g. UploadAppToStorage), which would throw at startup.
